title: Lineage tree screen with evidence inspector

claims.text: perform loads lineage_tree when available, otherwise pages agent_list with a stable head and strictly increasing cursor.
candidates filters by root scope and folded query and retains all canonical parent chains of matches.
evidence renders recorded inheritance, accepted eligible unit bodies, rejected reasons, birth constitution and parent constitution deltas.
render reveals at most fifty agents per generation, collapses subtrees and restores focus with caret position after render.
perform rejects identity key collisions and incoherent tree heads instead of rendering ambiguous lineage.

decision.rule: Change here when lineage loading, root and query filtering, reveal budgets, evidence rendering or collision handling needs to change.
decision.failure: Search drops canonical ancestors, a hidden selection stays active, or colliding identities render as distinct agents.

questions.q: Where does the Lineage screen load the tree from lineage_tree or paged agent_list?
Where should I change the per-generation reveal budget or collapse behaviour?
Where can I debug a lineage selection hidden by filters or pending expansion?
Where does the inspector show parent constitution changes?
